title: Bryan Danielson: title vs. career
summary: Danielson puts his future at stake to win AEW’s world championship, then faces betrayal from his own allies.

chapters.title: Danielson wins at Wembley
chapters.result: Danielson defeats Swerve in a title-versus-career match.
chapters.context: Victory preserves his career and delivers his first AEW world title.

chapters.title: His allies turn on him
chapters.result: Moxley and Claudio attack Danielson after his title defense.
chapters.context: The betrayal turns the champion’s own circle into his next threat.

chapters.title: Moxley ends the reign
chapters.result: Moxley defeats Danielson for the championship.
chapters.context: The result ends Danielson’s announced full-time run, not necessarily all future matches.
